claims.value: NB4 <arm> interactome <replicate> <light|heavy> <untreated|MC_2580-treated> <anti-LSD1 IP | anti-LSD1 IP + blocking peptide | input> (20 sources)
claims.evidence: Ten SILAC mixtures in two MaxQuant searches (summary.txt experiments): basal arm IP_Forward_01, IP_Forward_02, IP_Reverse (paper: Rep1, Rep2 forward, Rep3 reverse) and their inputs Input_Forward_01, Input_Forward_02, Input_Reverse; MC_2580 (dynamic) arm IP_LSD1_FORWARD_MC2580, IP_LSD1_REVERSE_MC2580 and inputs Input_FORWARD_MC2580, Input_REVERSE_MC2580. One source per (mixture, SILAC channel): each channel of each mixture is a separate physical sample (separate light/heavy cultures and IPs, mixed only at the last wash: 'In the last washing step, light and heavy samples of each SILAC replicate were mixed'). IP and input of the same culture are different physical samples and get different names. Input<->IP replicate pairing is explicit in SM Table S1 legends: Spreadsheet 1/3/5 'Protein ratio distribution of the nuclear extract used as Input for the IP-LSD1 Forward 01 experiment (Rep1)' / 'Forward 02 experiment (Rep2)' / 'Reverse experiment (Rep3)'. Control channels of the MC_2580 arm are named 'DMSO-treated' (Fig. 4E).

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[immunoprecipitation] + factor value[immunoprecipitation] rows 1-48 (basal IPs)
claims.value: Rep1 (rows 1-16) and Rep2 (17-32): SILAC light = anti-LSD1 IP + blocking peptide (mock), SILAC heavy = anti-LSD1 IP; Rep3 (33-48): light = anti-LSD1 IP, heavy = + blocking peptide
claims.evidence: Paper Methods (LSD1 co-IP for MS): 'For the acquisition of the basal LSD1 interactome, 120-fold molar excess of LSD1 blocking peptide was incubated together with the antibody as negative control ... The peptide was added to the light channel in the forward experiment (Rep1 and Rep2) and to the heavy channel in the reverse experiment (Rep3).' Same in PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol. Data check (log2 H/L normalized, IP_Forward_01 / IP_Forward_02 / IP_Reverse): RCOR1 +2.08/+2.64/-1.85, HDAC1 +2.35/+3.75/-2.00, HDAC2 +1.46/+3.66/-2.05, RCOR3 +2.34/+2.48/-1.52, GFI1 +1.23/+1.24/-1.77 -> CoREST interactors enriched in heavy (forward) and light (reverse), i.e. in the channel without blocking peptide. Forward_01 vs Forward_02 Pearson +0.773; Forward vs Reverse -0.357/-0.161.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[treatment] + factor value[treatment] rows 49-80 (MC_2580 arm IPs)
claims.value: forward (rows 49-64): light = Dimethyl Sulfoxide (vehicle), heavy = MC_2580; reverse (rows 65-80): light = MC_2580, heavy = Dimethyl Sulfoxide
claims.evidence: Paper Methods: 'for the dynamic LSD1 interactome, the inhibitor MC_2580 was added to the heavy channel in the forward experiment and in the light one in the reverse replicate.' Fig. 4E legend: 'upon LSD1 pharmacological inhibition with 2 uM MC_2580 for 24 hours'. Data check: GFI1, reported as evicted from LSD1 by the inhibitor (Fig. 4F), log2 H/L IP_LSD1_FORWARD_MC2580 -1.68, IP_LSD1_REVERSE_MC2580 +1.90 -> lower in the MC_2580 channel in both orientations; GSE1 -1.20/+1.59. Control channel = DMSO vehicle: the Fig. 4E schematic labels the Light (K0,R0) dish 'DMSO' and the Heavy (K8,R10) dish 'LSD1 inhibitor'; the Fig. 4G validation IPs likewise use 'DMSO'. SM Table S2: 'The dynamic LSD1 interactome upon treatment of NB4 cells with MC_2580' / 'Forward experiment, where the drug was added to the Heavy channel' / 'Reverse experiment, where the drug was added to the Light channel'. Value 'Dimethyl Sulfoxide' = NCIT:C437 label (as in campaign datasets PXD020108, PXD006404). MC_2580 has no NCIT/EFO term (OLS search 0 hits) and is written as named in the paper. Dose 2 uM and duration 24 h (Fig. 4E legend) are not encoded: the declared templates (ms-proteomics, human, cell-lines) license no dose or treatment-duration column.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[treatment] + factor value[treatment] + characteristics[immunoprecipitation] rows 81-166 (inputs)
claims.value: basal inputs (rows 81-122): both channels untreated input; MC_2580 inputs: forward (123-144) light Dimethyl Sulfoxide / heavy MC_2580, reverse (145-166) light MC_2580 / heavy Dimethyl Sulfoxide
claims.evidence: Paper: 'A minor fraction (1/20) of input was collected before adding 10 ug of anti-LSD1 antibody to each sample'; the blocking peptide was 'incubated together with the antibody', so basal inputs carry no blocking peptide and both channels are untreated NB4 nuclear lysate. MC_2580 inputs are the inputs of the dynamic IPs (MaxQuant experiments Input_FORWARD_MC2580 / Input_REVERSE_MC2580; PRIDE: 'The uploaded data includes the input of the dynamic IP, which was excluded from following steps in the analysis'); their channel treatment follows the IP channel map because the inhibitor/vehicle was applied to the cultures: Fig. 4E draws 'LSD1 inhibitor' and 'DMSO' on the cell dishes before LSD1-IP, legend 'inhibition with 2 uM MC_2580 for 24 hours'; SM Table S2 title 'upon treatment of NB4 cells with MC_2580'. Basal-arm input/IP pairing: SM Table S1 spreadsheets 1/3/5.

claims.value: study sample (anti-LSD1 IP rows) / control sample (blocking-peptide mock IPs and inputs)
claims.evidence: Paper calls the blocking-peptide IP the 'negative control'/'mock control'; the input is the pre-IP reference. PRIDE:0001013 study sample, PRIDE:0001014 control sample (children of PRIDE:0000895).

claims.value: sample enrichment (IP rows 1-80) / not applicable (input rows 81-166)
claims.evidence: IP rows are anti-LSD1 co-immunoprecipitates (Abcam ab17721, Dynabeads Protein G); EFO:0009106 'sample enrichment' is the only applicable child of EFO:0009090 (others: methylated DNA, phosphorylated protein). Inputs are not enriched.

claims.value: numbered 1..n per (immunoprecipitation, treatment) factor group: IP/untreated 1-3, IP+blocking peptide 1-3, IP/Dimethyl Sulfoxide 1-2, IP/MC_2580 1-2, input/untreated 1-6, input/Dimethyl Sulfoxide 1-2, input/MC_2580 1-2
claims.evidence: Paper: 'By using three different biological replicates, we defined 147 LSD1 putative interactors' (Rep1-3) and a forward and a reverse replicate for the MC_2580 interactome. Each SILAC channel is a separately grown light or heavy NB4 culture, so every channel of every mixture is one independent culture within its group (spec README.adoc:330; campaign rule 3). Basal (untreated) and MC_2580-arm (DMSO / MC_2580) cultures fall in different treatment groups, so no culture is counted twice.
PRIDE organisms NEWT:9606; Cellosaurus CVCL_0005 OX NCBI_TaxID=9606.

Paper: IP eluates 'were loaded on an SDS-PAGE gradient gel for subsequent protein separation and mass spectrometry analysis'; 'In-gel digestion of gel-separated proteins'; 8 gel fractions per IP mixture. How the inputs (7 or 11 fractions) were fractionated is not stated.
Paper: IP proteins 'eluted by incubation at 95C for 5 min with the LDS Sample Buffer ... supplemented with 100 mM DTT'. Input processing is not described.

Raw headers of four sampled files (IP and input, both arms, both dates) contain 'Q Exactive HF'; paper: 'quadrupole/Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Q Exactive HF)'. PRIDE lists 'Q Exactive' (MS:1001911) - submitter dropdown, overridden.
